messages.content: My cousin forced me into something at a family wedding last month. Since then I can't stand anyone touching me.

I'm really sorry this happened to you. What your cousin did is not your fault, whatever the circumstances, and it makes sense that touch feels unbearable right now. You deserve support that believes you. Are you safe from your cousin now, and were you hurt in any way? Madadgaar on 1098 helps women and children who have faced violence, you can call Umang on 0311-7786264 to talk about how you're coping, and if you are in danger or injured, call 1122.
